text:
maria: Cutting candidate build for the 9pm change window. tag=fwd-2026.03.18-cand3. Need pin and decision on hotfix merge by 7:30pm PT.

sanjay: quick ack. what's the diff vs cand2?

maria: small: revert of telemetry flag + kernel bump for batching perf. also a small patch to kv-cache TTL that caused a regression in perf tests.

olivia: QA ran smoke earlier, saw intermittent 504s on long-convo tests. sha was `sha256:aa1b2c3`. We repro'd and added a mitigation in branch `hotfix/cache-ttl` — should land in cand3.

shane: if hotfix goes in, we should pin the model artifact to avoid auto-roll to quantized variant during the promo. pin to `model:v2.1.0-unq`?

andrew: +1 pin. we had one incident where routing sent to v2.1-q mistakenly. pinning avoids fallback churn.

maria: deploy-bot, create candidate for `fwd-2026.03.18-cand3` and run canary smoke.

deploy-bot: Creating release candidate `fwd-2026.03.18-cand3`
  artifacts:
  - service-image: registry.redwood/inference:fwd-2026.03.18-cand3 (sha256:bb2c3d4)
  - model: model:v2.1.0-unq
  change-window: 2026-03-18T21:00:00-07:00 to 2026-03-18T23:00:00-07:00
  canary: route 2% to dedicated canary pool

qa-bot: Smoke results: 3/120 failures (timing out KV cache on long-convo). Re-ran after hotfix branch merged: 0/120 failures.

olivia: hotfix landed, CI green. please review release notes snippet.

maria: draft release notes:
```
- Reverted telemetry flag that caused high lock contention in shared caches.
- Kv-cache TTL fix to avoid stale entries causing timeouts under long-convo loads.
- Kernel bump to improve attention kernel throughput for batch sizes > 8.
- Model pinned to model:v2.1.0-unq to avoid quantized fallback during promotion.
```

sanjay: risk assessment? perf gain but larger kernel could increase GPU memory slightly. we tested on gpus in perf lab - peak +120MB for worst-case, still within Dedicated pool limits.

shane: rollback plan: if canary error rate > 1% for 10m, auto-fallback to `fwd-2026.03.17-cand2` and unpin model to previous variant. manual step to unroute traffic.

maria: noted. add monitoring alerts: latency p95 > 1.5s or error rate >1% triggers rollback play.

andrew: config diff for pinning (deploy config):
```
- model_selector: auto
+ model_selector: pinned
  pinned_model: model:v2.1.0-unq
```

olivia: can we get signoffs? ops: @shane, @andrew. qa: @olivia. eng: @sanjay.

shane: signoff from ops, monitoring configured. :thumbsup:

andrew: signoff from infra, image and model pinned, rollback steps documented.

sanjay: signoff from eng for candidate cut.

olivia: qa signoff. will watch the canary dashboard at 9pm.

maria: ok cutting the candidate now and scheduling promo for the 9pm window. tagging release doc and checklist.

deploy-bot: Candidate created and queued for canary promotion at 2026-03-18T21:00:00-07:00.

maria: if anything flaps, we'll call rollback. keep comms in this thread. :phone:

shane: thanks team — I'll be on standby.

olivia: monitoring playbooks open and alert routing set to oncall.

maria: last note: post-promo, run the eval-suite on sample prompts to validate quality regressions. we'll hold on final GA until evals green.

andrew: noted; will run evals automatically at +30m after promo.

maria: thanks everyone.
